issues.display_title: Issue #19: feat: implement LangChain vector store and hybrid retriever for base knowledge
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

The knowledge retrieval mechanism currently in app/rag/retriever.py uses basic token frequency scoring and stop-word matching:

  1. Keyword-Only Matching: User queries containing synonyms, colloquial phrasing, or differing grammar frequently miss relevant GoThru documentation in base-knowledge/.
  2. No Semantic Search: The system cannot perform dense semantic vector retrieval over the knowledge documents and action workflows.
  3. Limited Re-indexing & Retrieval Modularity: The indexer and retriever are custom in-memory loops that do not leverage proven hybrid retrieval patterns (BM25 + Dense Vector embeddings).

Proposed Solution

Upgrade the RAG indexing and retrieval subsystem to LangChain:

  • Represent GoThru markdown docs and action contracts as LangChain Document objects with standardized metadata.
  • Implement hybrid retrieval combining lexical search (BM25) and dense embeddings via a local, self-hosted vector store.
  • Support dynamic catalog and base knowledge re-indexing via the existing admin reload endpoint without requiring server restarts.
  • Ensure 100% self-hosted operation with zero external third-party vector databases or telemetry dependencies.

Technical Design

  • Document Representation (app/copilot/models.py & app/rag/): Convert KnowledgeDocument to LangChain Document containing chunked body and rich metadata.
  • Hybrid Retrieval (app/rag/retriever.py): Combine BM25Retriever with local/provider embeddings vector store using an ensemble or reciprocal rank fusion strategy.
  • Endpoints Integration (app/api/routes_chat.py & app/api/routes_actions.py): Connect /chat and /suggest-action to the updated hybrid retriever while maintaining conversation history query expansion.
  • Admin Ingestion (app/rag/indexer.py): Ensure persistence and hot-reload capabilities remain intact for uploaded action files.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Wrap knowledge documents into LangChain Document format with metadata
  • Implement self-hosted vector store and hybrid retrieval (BM25 + embeddings)
  • Maintain fallback query expansion when conversation history is present
  • Support hot-reloading through /admin/reload-catalog and action uploads
  • Add unit tests covering hybrid retrieval precision and indexer rebuilds

issues.display_title: Issue #23: feat: enhance conversation context retention for follow-up queries
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

During multi-turn conversations, the GoThru Ask AI chatbot can lose conversational context when users respond with step-by-step follow-up questions (such as confirming they completed a step or asking what to do next).

Problem

In interactive workflows, users often follow instructions step by step:

  1. User: "How do I unarchive tour from Google in GoThru?"
  2. AI: Provides steps 1 through 6 (step 3 suggests navigating to the Tour Details page).
  3. User: "Ok I'm already on details tour page, what next?"
  4. AI: "I apologize, but the provided information does not contain details on how to unarchive a tour..."

Why this happens:
The knowledge retrieval system only searched using the user's latest follow-up sentence ("ok I'm already on details tour page"). Without carrying forward the primary topic from earlier (unarchive tour), the search retrieved unrelated documents, leading the AI to lose track of the active task.

Proposed Enhancement

Enhance conversational context handling during document retrieval:

  • Intelligent Follow-up Detection: Automatically detect continuation phrases and transition markers (e.g., "ok", "already on page...", "what next?", "how to do that?", in both English and Indonesian).
  • Seamless Context Merging: When a follow-up is recognized, automatically combine the prior user inquiry with the follow-up message so document search stays focused on the active workflow.
  • Independent New Inquiries: When users ask about a brand-new topic, keep the query independent without mixing in previous discussion topics.

Expected User Experience

  • Users can naturally interact with the AI step by step without having to repeat their original question.
  • The assistant provides continuous, context-aware answers tailored to the user's current progress in the workflow.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Follow-up messages (English and Indonesian) are accurately detected
  • Document retrieval preserves the active task context for follow-up questions
  • New, standalone questions remain independent from previous conversation turns
  • Automated unit and integration test suites pass for follow-up conversation scenarios

issues.display_title: Issue #25: feat: integrate CockroachDB for persistent base knowledge and native vector retrieval
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

Currently, GoThru RAG Copilot stores knowledge documents, action workflows, and vector embeddings solely in-memory with optional JSON cache files (storage/rag/actions.json):

  1. Volatile & Ephemeral Storage: In-memory vector stores require re-indexing and re-embedding documents on every application reload or cold start, leading to slow startup times and unnecessary API calls.
  2. Lack of Native Vector Search at Database Layer: Knowledge documents and action contracts lack a unified, scalable relational schema supporting native cosine distance calculations and indexation.
  3. Admin Ingestion Persistence Gaps: Uploaded action workflows and documents are stored on local disk and memory without transactional database guarantees or relational integrity.

Proposed Solution

Integrate CockroachDB (v24.3.5+) as the persistent primary knowledge store with native vector search:

  • Use raw parameterized SQL via asynchronous connection pooling (psycopg3 and psycopg-pool) without heavyweight ORM overhead.
  • Design relational tables for knowledge_documents (with native VECTOR({dimension}) column) and action_contracts with cascading foreign keys.
  • Upgrade ActionRetriever to query CockroachDB's native cosine_distance() function and fuse results with BM25 lexical ranking via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).
  • Automatically synchronize Admin API operations (single upload, batch upload, delete, re-ingest) to CockroachDB.
  • Provide a standalone CLI seeder script to populate CockroachDB directly from existing markdown directories.
  • Gracefully fall back to in-memory retrieval if the database is unconfigured.

Technical Design

  • Configuration & Connection (app/core/config.py, app/db/connection.py):
    • Added DATABASE_URL, EMBEDDING_DIMENSION, DB_POOL_MIN_SIZE, DB_POOL_MAX_SIZE.
    • Managed AsyncConnectionPool lifecycle via FastAPI lifespan.
    • Automated DDL initialization for knowledge_documents and action_contracts tables.
  • Data Access Repository (app/db/repository.py):
    • Created CockroachRepository providing CRUD operations and vector similarity search.
    • Vector similarity search utilizing CockroachDB native cosine_distance(embedding, $1::VECTOR).
  • Hybrid Retrieval (app/rag/retriever.py):
    • Implemented async asearch() with RRF combining CockroachDB vector ranks and BM25 scores.
    • Updated /chat and /suggest-action routes to consume await _retriever.asearch().
  • Admin Sync & Seeder (app/api/routes_admin.py, scripts/seed_cockroach.py, scripts/crdb.sh):
    • Synchronized action uploads, batch uploads, and deletions with CockroachDB.
    • Added CLI migration script scripts/seed_cockroach.py supporting batching and embedding generation.
    • Added operational CLI management script scripts/crdb.sh.
  • Health & Lifecycle (app/main.py):
    • Added CockroachDB connectivity check to /health endpoint.
  • Local Development Environment (docker-compose.yml, Standalone Binary):
    • Added single-node CockroachDB v24.3.5 container definition and rootless standalone binary instructions.
  • Documentation (docs/features/cockroachdb.md):
    • Added comprehensive documentation covering schema, setup, operations, and troubleshooting.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Add psycopg & psycopg-pool dependencies and configure DB connection pool with FastAPI lifespan.
  • Initialize schema DDL for knowledge_documents (with VECTOR column) and action_contracts with cascade deletes.
  • Implement CockroachRepository with parameterized raw SQL for CRUD and cosine distance search.
  • Implement hybrid retrieval in ActionRetriever.asearch() combining CockroachDB vector search and BM25 via RRF.
  • Update /chat and /suggest-action routes to support asynchronous retrieval.
  • Integrate Admin API endpoints (/actions, /actions/batch, /actions/{slug}, /ingest/actions) with CockroachDB.
  • Create CLI seeder script (scripts/seed_cockroach.py) for syncing markdown files to DB.
  • Update /health endpoint to monitor and report database readiness.
  • Add comprehensive unit and integration tests for DB connection, repository, retriever, admin routes, and seeder.

Overview

Enable seamless, bidirectional interaction between GoThru Dashboard, Frontend RAG Widget, and the GoThru RAG Backend, allowing the AI assistant to be context-aware of the user's active page and trigger native dashboard actions (such as opening the Tour Creation modal) via interactive Call-To-Action (CTA) buttons in chat.

  1. Dashboard → Widget → RAG (Page Context):

    • Host dashboard synchronizes active route and page metadata into window.__GOTHRU_PAGE_STATE__.
    • The RAG widget captures this alongside recent conversation history into distinct namespaces (context.history and context.page) to prevent data collision.

  2. RAG Backend (Intent Detection & Client Actions):

    • The Copilot Planner detects client-side UI action intents (e.g., create_hosted_tour, create_google_business, /storage, /my-tours).
    • Responds with an optional client_action payload attached to both imperative (action_available) and informational (answer_only) modes.

  3. Widget → Dashboard (Interactive Event Dispatching):

    • The widget renders an interactive button below the AI response bubble (e.g., [ Create Hosted Tour ]).
    • When clicked, it emits a standard browser event: 
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('gothru:action', { detail: client_action }));
    • A global listener in the Dashboard Layout receives the signal and mounts the requested modal or navigates to the target page.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Query "how to creating a virtual tour in GoThru?" returns step-by-step guidance + client_action targeting create_hosted_tour.
  • Query "create a new hosted tour" returns action_available mode + client_action.
  • Clicking the CTA button in the chat widget opens the native Hosted Tour modal in the dashboard.
  • Page context (route, page_title) is passed without overwriting chat history.
  • Full test suites pass with 0 regressions.

Implementation Results: Available Client Actions

All client actions are fully implemented with active page awareness (evaluating active route and tour ID) and smart auto-triggering (imperative commands trigger instant execution with a concise confirmation; informational inquiries present interactive CTA buttons without force-navigating).

  • Context Awareness: When inside an existing tour (tour_id present), queries for uploading, managing, editing, and publishing are strictly scoped to the active tour instead of advising users to create a new tour.

    • Imperative navigation commands (e.g., "open...", "go to..."): auto_trigger: true (executes immediately with concise 1-sentence confirmation).
    • Informational / how-to queries (e.g., "how to..."): auto_trigger: false (renders clean interactive pill button below the step-by-step guidance without force-navigating).
  • Clean Action Button Design: Removed redundant + icon, displaying clean, responsive pill CTA buttons.
